muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is a fast bitboard negamax search with alpha-beta, iterative deepening under ~0.9s, static + dynamic evaluation favouring corners, X/C safety, mobility, frontier and disc parity, and exact solving in the endgame.
muse_spark_1.3/002: Strong Othello requires corners, mobility and parity with tactical search. This policy uses 64-bit bitboards with fast parallel move generation, PST + mobility + corners + X/C danger + frontier + disc parity evaluation phase-weighted, and time-limited iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta and ordered moves, falling back to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is mobility plus corners with fast bitboards and alpha-beta search. All moves, flips and frontier are computed with 64-bit integer shifts, giving thousands of nodes per millisecond in pure Python. Evaluation rewards corner occupancy very highly, punishes X/C squares next to empty corners, rewards mobility, penalizes frontier discs and adds a phase-dependent disc-parity term. The root takes an immediate corner if available, orders remaining moves by classic piece-square weights, then runs iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta, pass handling, exact terminal scoring and timeout protection, falling back to a greedy legal move to always satisfy the rules.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is fast bitboard negamax with alpha-beta, iterative deepening, perfect endgame solve and a strong positional evaluation. Moves are generated with parallel directional bit-shifts, flips by single-ray walks, evaluation combines corners, X/C-square penalties, mobility, frontier, piece-square tables and phase-dependent parity. Root search orders by static weights and previous iteration scores under a time budget.
muse_spark_1.3/005: Strong Othello requires corners, mobility and stability, not disc count. This policy uses fast 64-bit bitboards, parallel move generation, exact flip calculation, a phased evaluation with positional weights, corner bonuses, X/C-square penalties when the corner is empty, mobility, frontier and parity, plus alpha-beta negamax with transposition table, move ordering and iterative deepening. Endgames with few empties are solved exactly, midgame is searched to depth 5-7 under a strict time limit, always falling back to a legal move.
